description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Assured is building a new generation of products for the insurance industry. We’re helping people move through the claims process with less confusion and giving the teams supporting them better ways to get things done.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to own our Services experience, helping people take the practical next steps after an accident, from arranging a rental car to getting their vehicle repaired. You’ll shape how people access and manage these services, whether they’re completing a task themselves or working with an adjuster or customer support representative.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product Design. You’ll own the design direction and quality of service workflows across our consumer and adjuster products, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and other designers from early problem framing through launch and iteration.

The opportunity is to make the whole journey feel connected: helping people understand their options, take action, and know what happens next, while giving the teams supporting them the context and tools to keep things moving.

🎯 What you’ll do

  • Set the design direction and lead execution for post claim filing service experiences such as Repair management, rental car selection, tow scheduling etc across consumer and adjuster products.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering early to frame problems, shape how services work, and prioritize improvements across the journey.

  • Build a deep understanding of claimants, adjusters, and customer support representatives, including what each person needs to move a claim forward.

  • Design clear ways to choose and arrange services, follow progress, and handle changes or delays.

  • Make transitions between self-service and assisted support feel connected, preserving context so people don’t have to start over.

  • Move from exploration and prototyping into detailed interaction and visual design, partnering with Engineering through implementation.

  • Work with designers across our products to develop shared patterns and make service workflows feel cohesive wherever people encounter them.

  • Work directly with users and customers to test ideas, learn from real use, and improve task completion, clarity, and handoffs.

🧠 What we’re looking for

  • Experience setting design direction and leading substantial product design work in complex workflows, ideally connecting consumer experiences with tools for the teams supporting them.

  • Strong craft across interaction design, information architecture, and visual design, with a portfolio that shows how you make complex experiences clear and usable.

  • Systems thinking: the ability to connect individual interactions to the people, workflows, and operational constraints around them.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering from discovery through shipped experiences, making thoughtful tradeoffs along the way.

  • The ability to create clarity, build alignment across teams, and take responsibility for the quality of the overall experience.

  • A practical approach to research and iteration, with examples of how feedback and real use shaped what you shipped.

✨ You might be a great fit if...

You enjoy connecting the small interaction details to the larger experience. You can make a task feel simple for someone navigating an unfamiliar situation while giving the people helping them the information and control they need.

You’re comfortable working across product boundaries and getting deep into how things actually work. You care about what happens between steps, who needs to act next, and whether the experience holds together when plans change.

Insurance experience is not required. Curiosity, strong product judgment, and the ability to make unfamiliar, complex problems understandable matter much more.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

**We have been made aware of individuals falsely posing as recruiters from Assured Insurance Technologies Inc. Please note that we only contact candidates from official @assured.claims email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information**
